jira_tickets.title: Auth service integration failing on staging
jira_tickets.description: OAuth2 flow breaks when redirecting from staging environment. Tokens expire immediately.

jira_tickets.title: Fix race condition in payment processing
jira_tickets.description: Duplicate charges occurring under high concurrency. Mutex not working as expected.

jira_tickets.title: Database migration for user schema v3
jira_tickets.description: Need to add new fields for user preferences and notification settings.

jira_tickets.title: Implement email notification templates
jira_tickets.description: Build HTML email templates for welcome, password reset, and weekly digest.

jira_tickets.title: Dashboard loading performance optimization
jira_tickets.description: Dashboard takes 4+ seconds to load. Need to optimize API calls and add caching.

jira_tickets.title: Set up CI/CD pipeline for staging
jira_tickets.description: GitHub Actions pipeline for automated testing and staging deployment.

jira_tickets.title: User profile page redesign
jira_tickets.description: Redesign user profile with new avatar upload and bio section.

jira_tickets.title: Add unit tests for payment module
jira_tickets.description: 80% coverage target for payment processing module.

jira_tickets.title: Implement search autocomplete
jira_tickets.description: Add typeahead search suggestions to the main search bar.

jira_tickets.title: Fix mobile responsive layout issues
jira_tickets.description: Sidebar overlaps main content on screens < 768px.

jira_tickets.title: API rate limiting middleware
jira_tickets.description: Implement rate limiting to prevent API abuse. 100 req/min per user.

jira_tickets.title: Logging and monitoring setup
jira_tickets.description: Set up structured logging with ELK stack and Grafana dashboards.

jira_tickets.title: Implement payment gateway webhook handler
jira_tickets.description: Handle Stripe webhook events for payment confirmation, refunds, and disputes.

jira_tickets.title: Email notification preferences UI
jira_tickets.description: Settings page for users to configure which email notifications they receive.

jira_tickets.title: Integrate third-party analytics SDK
jira_tickets.description: Add Mixpanel tracking for user engagement metrics.

jira_tickets.title: Admin dashboard role-based access control
jira_tickets.description: Implement role-based access for admin, manager, and viewer roles.

jira_tickets.title: SSO integration with corporate IdP
jira_tickets.description: Need SAML metadata from customer IT team. Waiting on external dependency.

jira_tickets.title: Load testing infrastructure setup
jira_tickets.description: Blocked on AWS account approval for load testing environment.

jira_tickets.title: User onboarding flow redesign
jira_tickets.description: New 3-step onboarding wizard with progress indicator.

jira_tickets.title: API documentation with Swagger UI
jira_tickets.description: Auto-generate API docs from FastAPI schemas. Add example requests.

slack_messages.author: Priya Kumar
slack_messages.text: Still waiting on the auth service to be ready, been a week now. This is getting ridiculous.

slack_messages.author: Raj Mehta
slack_messages.text: Can someone from backend take a look at PROJ-142? We're blocked on this and it's holding up everything.

slack_messages.author: Sarah Chen
slack_messages.text: The migration script keeps failing. I've been debugging this for two days and still no update from the DBA team.

slack_messages.author: Priya Kumar
slack_messages.text: Nobody has responded to my auth service PR review request. It's been 4 days.

slack_messages.author: Raj Mehta
slack_messages.text: pushed another hotfix, third one this week. The payment race condition is really frustrating.

slack_messages.author: Alex Rivera
slack_messages.text: Email templates are done! Moving on to the notification service integration.

slack_messages.author: Sarah Chen
slack_messages.text: Why are we still on the old schema? This migration should have been done last sprint.

slack_messages.author: Priya Kumar
slack_messages.text: I'm blocked on PROJ-142 and PROJ-168. Can't make progress on either without external input.

slack_messages.author: Raj Mehta
slack_messages.text: Finally fixed the unit tests. At least something is working.

slack_messages.author: Alex Rivera
slack_messages.text: Rate limiting middleware is merged and deployed. Working great in staging.

slack_messages.author: Sarah Chen
slack_messages.text: Has anyone heard back from the DBA team? I sent two emails and got ignored.

slack_messages.author: Priya Kumar
slack_messages.text: Feeling stuck. Auth and SSO are both waiting on other teams. Nothing I can do.

slack_messages.author: Raj Mehta
slack_messages.text: The concurrency issue is worse than we thought. Need to rethink the locking strategy entirely.

slack_messages.author: Alex Rivera
slack_messages.text: Great standup today, feels like we have a clear plan for the notification system.

slack_messages.author: Sarah Chen
slack_messages.text: Started the migration work. Hopeful I can get it done by Wednesday.

slack_messages.author: Priya Kumar
slack_messages.text: Auth service initial setup is done. Now need to integrate with staging. Should be straightforward.

slack_messages.author: Raj Mehta
slack_messages.text: Payment tests all passing. Good progress this week.

slack_messages.author: Emma Wilson
slack_messages.text: Profile page redesign is shipped! Really happy with how it turned out.

slack_messages.author: Mike Johnson
slack_messages.text: Dashboard performance is improving. Down to 2.1s load time from 4.3s.

slack_messages.author: Emma Wilson
slack_messages.text: Thanks @Mike for the responsive fixes, mobile looks great now!

slack_messages.author: Mike Johnson
slack_messages.text: Search autocomplete is working nicely. Users will love this feature.

slack_messages.author: Emma Wilson
slack_messages.text: Starting the onboarding flow today. The wireframes look clean.

slack_messages.author: Mike Johnson
slack_messages.text: Waiting on the backend API for the notification preferences. Can't build the UI without it.

slack_messages.author: Emma Wilson
slack_messages.text: Onboarding wizard step 1 is done. Moving to step 2. This is going well.

slack_messages.author: Mike Johnson
slack_messages.text: Fixed the sidebar overlap bug. CSS grid was the issue.

slack_messages.author: Emma Wilson
slack_messages.text: Good sprint so far for frontend. We're ahead of schedule on most items.

slack_messages.author: Mike Johnson
slack_messages.text: Analytics SDK integration is next week. Low priority but important for product.

slack_messages.author: Emma Wilson
slack_messages.text: Started the profile redesign. Using the new component library — it's really nice to work with.

slack_messages.author: Mike Johnson
slack_messages.text: Performance audit results are in. Main bottleneck is the dashboard API call — need backend to optimize.

slack_messages.author: Emma Wilson
slack_messages.text: Sprint planning went well. Realistic goals this time. Feeling good about delivery.

slack_messages.author: David Park
slack_messages.text: CI/CD pipeline is fully operational. All merges to main now auto-deploy to staging.

slack_messages.author: Priya Kumar
slack_messages.text: Can someone from leadership prioritize PROJ-142? It's been stuck for over a week and blocks 4 other tickets.

slack_messages.author: David Park
slack_messages.text: Monitoring dashboards are live. We can now see error rates and latency in real time.

slack_messages.author: Raj Mehta
slack_messages.text: Payment processing had 3 incidents this week. We need to address the race condition before launch.

slack_messages.author: Emma Wilson
slack_messages.text: Frontend sprint velocity is looking good. We should hit all our targets.

slack_messages.author: Sarah Chen
slack_messages.text: Database migration is taking longer than expected. Schema changes are more complex than we scoped.

slack_messages.author: David Park
slack_messages.text: Load testing is blocked on AWS account approval. Submitted the request 3 days ago.

slack_messages.author: Priya Kumar
slack_messages.text: Sprint 23 midpoint check: backend is behind, frontend is on track. We need to discuss priorities.

slack_messages.author: Alex Rivera
slack_messages.text: Notification service architecture is finalized. Starting implementation tomorrow.

slack_messages.author: Mike Johnson
slack_messages.text: Great collaboration with backend team on the API contracts. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

slack_messages.author: David Park
slack_messages.text: Grafana dashboards are set up. Logging is centralized. We're in good shape for observability.

slack_messages.author: Sarah Chen
slack_messages.text: Migration work is starting. I have a plan but it's going to be tight.

slack_messages.author: Raj Mehta
slack_messages.text: Payment module tests are all green. Confident in the core logic, just need to fix the concurrency edge case.

slack_messages.author: Emma Wilson
slack_messages.text: UI component library is updated. All new components follow the design system now.

slack_messages.author: David Park
slack_messages.text: Welcome to Sprint 23 everyone! Let's make it a great one.

slack_messages.author: Priya Kumar
slack_messages.text: Quick reminder: PROJ-142 auth service is critical path. If this slips, payment integration can't start.

slack_messages.author: Mike Johnson
slack_messages.text: Dashboard perf optimization PR is up for review. Would appreciate eyes on it.

slack_messages.author: Alex Rivera
slack_messages.text: API docs are coming along nicely. Should have Swagger UI ready by end of week.

slack_messages.author: Raj Mehta
slack_messages.text: Still working on the payment race condition. This is harder than expected.

slack_messages.author: Sarah Chen
slack_messages.text: Migration script draft is ready but I need DBA review before running it. Still no response from them.

sprint_data.sprint_goal: Complete auth integration, payment processing, and user onboarding
